$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-art.mjs (Retro Diffusion). Each kind has its style, size and the approved sprites used as style references (art/references/<kind>/<id>.png). Approved sprites go to src/client/art/<kind>/<id>.png. The portraits are the starting look: plain clothes and empty hands, as characters start with nothing. portraits-evolved holds the prompts of the earlier, well-equipped portraits, kept in art/evolution/portraits/ for the look after the first class evolution. materials holds the materials left by creatures, the parts made on the Stół rzemieślniczy and the treasure chest (data/materials.json). areas holds the inner regions, each a scene in a circle on the Walka screen, and lands the wide, dim backgrounds behind the cards of the lands (regions.json); both keep their background (removeBackground: false).
